puzzles.description: Sort citizen requests into correct queue priority order — highest urgency first
hints: Expiring permits are the most urgent — they have a deadline. What's least urgent?
Permits expire (urgent), safety incidents need action, general enquiries can wait, feedback is lowest priority.
Order: Work Pass Permits → Workplace Safety → General Enquiry → Feedback

puzzles.description: Chain the contact flow blocks in the correct order to route calls
hints: Every call starts with a greeting. What does the caller do next — identify their need.
After greeting and input: check if agents are free, put caller in queue, then connect them.
Order: Play Greeting → Get Customer Input → Check Queue Availability → Transfer to Queue → Connect to Agent. Hold Music is a distractor.

puzzles.description: Complete the After Contact Work form by keeping correct entries and removing incorrect ones

config.shelfLabel: ACW form fields — tap to remove incorrect entries
config.intro:
📞 CALL TRANSCRIPT:
"Hello, I submitted my work permit renewal three weeks ago — reference WP-20240815. I was told it would take 10 working days but I haven't received any update. My current permit expires next week and I'm worried I'll be out of compliance. Can someone check the status?"

Complete the After Contact Work form below. Remove incorrect entries — keep only what matches the call.

documents.label: Category: Work Permit Renewal
documents.missingLine: ⚠️ Missing category — case cannot be classified

documents.label: Category: Salary Dispute
documents.poisonLine: ❌ Wrong category — this isn't a salary issue

documents.label: Reference: WP-20240815
documents.missingLine: ⚠️ No reference number — case cannot be traced

documents.label: Reference: SD-20240101
documents.poisonLine: ❌ Wrong reference number — doesn't match caller's case

documents.label: Summary: Permit renewal submitted 3 weeks ago, no update received, expires next week
documents.missingLine: ⚠️ Missing summary — follow-up team won't know the issue

documents.label: Summary: Caller wants to file a new application
documents.poisonLine: ❌ Inaccurate summary — caller is checking status, not filing new

documents.label: Follow-up: Escalate to permits team for expedited status check
documents.missingLine: ⚠️ No follow-up action — case will sit unresolved

documents.label: Follow-up: No action required, case closed
documents.poisonLine: ❌ Case isn't resolved — citizen still waiting for an answer

hints: Read the transcript. What is the caller's issue? Match category, reference, summary, and follow-up.
It's a work permit renewal (not salary). Reference WP-20240815. They want a status check, not a new application.
Keep: Work Permit Renewal + WP-20240815 + 'submitted 3 weeks ago' summary + escalate to permits team. Remove everything else.
